XOOTEQ: Single-Family Minimal

Install these free fonts (SIL Open Font License) for Figma, Adobe and Canva:

  Headlines            Schibsted Grotesk (600, 800)
                       https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Schibsted+Grotesk

  Body                 Schibsted Grotesk (400, 500)
                       https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Schibsted+Grotesk

  Data, dates, labels  JetBrains Mono (400, 500)
                       https://fonts.google.com/specimen/JetBrains+Mono

Type scale (ratio 1.333):
  caption   web      9 px   poster   13.5 px
  small     web     12 px   poster     18 px
  body      web     16 px   poster     24 px
  lead      web   21.3 px   poster     32 px
  h3        web   28.4 px   poster   42.6 px
  h2        web   37.9 px   poster   56.8 px
  h1        web   50.5 px   poster   75.8 px
  display   web   89.8 px   poster  134.6 px
  hero      web  159.5 px   poster  239.3 px

Rules:
  - Two families at most (display + body), plus a mono for small data such as dates, prices and codes.
  - Sentence case everywhere. All capitals only for short labels of one to three words, with letter-spacing.
  - Three sizes per piece is usually enough: headline, body, small.
  - Big headlines get tight leading (about 1.0) and slightly negative tracking; body text gets 1.5 leading and lines of 45-75 characters.
  - Left-align text. Centre only one or two short lines on a centred poster.
  - Handwriting fonts only as one short accent, from source/handwritten.json, where the style allows it (approaches/<id>/typography.json -> handwritten). Never for body, prices, data, steps or buttons.
  - Match headline weight to the illustration: the stems of headline letters should be about as thick as the ink line.
